text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I ended up... coming to watch...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Did you hear that Mihono Bourbon, who's 
running today, is aiming for the Classic 
Triple Crown?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"I heard, I heard. Isn't she a sprint 
specialist, though?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly. Even though everyone always 
said they were built to be a sprinter. 
Trainer's really letting talent go to 
waste, huh.

The hushed murmur of the grandstands 
softly echoed even down into the 
underground tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...At the Asahi Hai FS, I will fulfill the 
order to 'convince the world' without 
fail.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list: Go and run with everything you've got!
Go run with everything you've got!
